Problem Statement:
Mr. Kanga had a PhD in Heap Algorithms. Today, he was given a list of strings in random order. Help him sort the list in increasing order(lexicographically increasing) using heap sort.
input_spec: The first line is an integer N denoting the number of strings.The next line contains N space separated strings containing lower case English Alphabets.
output_spec: Print N space separated strings in increasing order.
